en: Black‑and‑white view over a hilly European town. In the foreground are plastered two‑ and three‑storey houses with steep tiled roofs, fenced gardens, and a narrow street with a few horse‑drawn carts. Behind them rise terraced grassy slopes with scattered fruit trees and wooden fences. In the hazy distance on a hill stands a large fortress‑like castle complex with towers and a central keep, overlooking the town. The picture has wide borders and the overall appearance of an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.
